'''Berchest''' was a major tourist destination, and later a trading [[Planet/Legends|planet]], in the [[Anthos sector/Legends|Anthos sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was an extremely beautiful world whose highly [[Salt/Legends|saline]] [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] and strong tides result in immense [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] deposits on the planet's shores that the native [[Berchestian]]s sculpted into entire [[City/Legends|cities]]. One of these cities was [[Calius saj Leeloo]], or the City of Glowing Crystal. It was carved entirely from one massive crystal that was created over the centuries from salt deposits from the adjacent [[Leefari Sea]] and was considered one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]].

==History==
[[File:Calius_Saj_Leeloo.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The city of [[Calius saj Leeloo]], one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]].]]
The planet suffered a major [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. It was [[Battle of Berchest|liberated]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] by [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom|Freedom's Sons]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. Though the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] cut into the planet's tourism, the planet was able to leverage its position on several important trade routes and turn itself into an important trade nexus. During the [[Thrawn campaign]], Berchest was well behind [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] lines, and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] used the world as a red herring for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] attempt to follow deployment of his new [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces. It was ruled by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Raccyx Staffa]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Berchest in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Fakir sector is actually located in the Inner Rim.
